post.caption:
Entry, descent and landing on Mars takes about seven minutes, and the signal takes longer than that to reach Earth, so it is over before we know it started. Nobody flies it and nobody can. Heat shield, then parachute, then both discarded and rockets lit, then the sky crane hovering and lowering the rover on cables so landing legs do not dig into unsurveyed ground. Full autonomy is not a feature there. It is the only option available.
